summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested recursive add_to_cbd helper implementing the W3C CBD rules: rule 1 subject triples with blank-node recursion guarded by the result's existing subject triples; rule 2 includes every rdf:subject reifier's triples with no rdf:Statement or predicate/object checks; no expansion of reifier blank-node objects. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py (class CbdTestCase, camelCase test methods, imports only unittest and Graph/Namespace, main guard). Tests were not run, per instructions; expected counts were hand-computed against my own fixture, not the reference fixture. No docs page added. Nothing committed.
